description: Listspace checks. Decision check: when the user decides something in a session that uses Listspace and no decision was recorded, Claude is sent back once to check and record it as Proposed. Progress check: when a turn in a session that uses Listspace changed files, committed, pushed, opened or merged a pull request or deployed, and told the board nothing, Claude is sent back once to move the item and add a short comment. Board context: at the start of a session and after a compaction, in a project that names its Listspace board or a session that uses Listspace, Claude gets the board rule and is told to start from the board or to look up its open work; after a command that opens or merges a pull request or deploys, one line says to move the item and comment. Context only, it never blocks. Each command ends in exit 0, so a computer without Node.js shows no hook error.
